title: Federation
parity_no_reports_hint: Reports are generated when there are transactions with federated nodes.
parity_fc_remote_hint: The remote node has not shared its CF
limits_propose_desc: Select a federated node and propose new limits. The other node must confirm.
limits_no_federated_hint: To propose a bilateral limit, you must first register a peer node.
limits_no_bilateral: No custom bilateral limits. All nodes use the base limit.
limits_change_hint: This request will go to the assembly for voting. Members will decides whether to approve the change.
merge_how_works_desc: When two nodes federate, if there are users registered in both with the same national ID, both assemblies must agree on which node each person stays and what to do with the balance. While there are unresolved conflicts, federation cannot be completed.
merge_scan_desc: Enter the domain of the other node to search for duplicate users by national ID.
merge_no_conflicts_hint: Scan another node to detect duplicates.
merge_blocked_hint: Blocked - both assemblies must reach consensus
merge_which_node: Which node does the user stay in?
merge_no_dual: Dual membership is not allowed. The user stays in one node only.
merge_balance_action: What to do with the balances?
merge_forgive_debt: Forgive debt of the removed node
merge_remove_balance: Discard balance of the removed node
discover_federation_personal: Federation is done personally, not automatically
discover_federation_personal_desc: This system does NOT federate nodes with one click. The public key for federating is shared personally between people, not through the system. Here you only see information about other nodes (country, location, governance, web, contact) so you can communicate with them directly. The idea is to have human contact, for people to meet, for assemblies to approve, and then share keys in person.
discover_how_works_desc: There is no central server. Each node shares its list of known nodes with federated nodes, and they in turn share it with theirs. Thus, it is enough for one node to federate with just one other for the entire network to discover it. To federate, contact the person responsible for the other node personally and exchange public keys.
discover_search_placeholder: Search by domain, name, country or location...
discover_federated_hint: Federated nodes are not removed even if they are offline. They only show their current status.
discover_no_discovered_hint: Federate with a node to start discovering more nodes in the network via gossip.
discover_inactive_desc: These nodes were marked as inactive because all nodes in the network reported that they cannot connect with them. It is not that a single node could not (it may not have internet), but that all confirmed it does not respond. They are kept internally to continue checking if they reappear someday, but are not shown in the main list.
discover_requests_not_auto: Contact requests do not federate automatically. They are a way to express interest and share contact information.
discover_auto_federation: Global automatic federation: When confirming a pairing with 4-option verification, the new node enters the entire federated network automatically. The sponsor propagates the new node's info to all its peers in exponential chain, and each node establishes an individual 1-to-1 relationship. You do not need to manually federate with each node.
discover_fed_pairings_desc: A new node requests to federate. The new node communicated a 6-digit code by phone. Click Confirm to see 4 options and choose the correct one. Upon confirming, the node will enter the entire federated network automatically via chain propagation.
discover_select_code: Choose the code communicated by the new node:
discover_federate_hint: To federate: contact this person personally, review your governance, assemblies approve, and then share public keys in person. It is not federated with one click.
discover_no_sent_requests: You have not sent any requests
discover_config_desc: Configure how often your node shares its list, verifies if nodes are active, and cleans up inactive ones. Each node can have its own configuration.
discover_share_interval_hint: How often your node shares its list of known nodes with peers. Default: 24 hours.
discover_health_interval_hint: How often your node verifies if discovered nodes are still active. Default: 168 hours (7 days). An inactive node is decided by consensus of the entire network, not by your single check.
discover_cleanup_interval_hint: How often inactive nodes are removed from the visible list. They are kept internally to continue checking. Default: 365 days.
discover_max_failed_hint: How many times a node must fail your verification before requesting consensus from other nodes. Default: 3.
discover_request_modal_desc: You will send a contact request to another node. This does not federate automatically. The other node will see your information and can contact you personally to federate.
discover_request_contact_hint: How the other node can contact you
gov_no_proposals_hint: Create a proposal to change a value that affects the entire federation.
gov_auto_applied: Change applied automatically on all nodes.
gov_constants_federated: These constants are federated: they are the same on all nodes. They cannot be edited directly. To change them, create a proposal in the New Proposal tab.
gov_new_proposal_desc: Propose a change that will affect all nodes in the federation. All federated nodes will have to approve the change. When consensus is reached, the change is applied automatically.
gov_which_constant: Which constant do you want to change?
gov_no_known_nodes: No known nodes. This is the only node.
gov_expelled_desc: These nodes were expelled by federation vote. To re-enter, they must request admission again and will automatically accept all existing rules.
gov_expel_domain: Domain of the node to expel
gov_expel_reason_hint: Explain why this node should be expelled. All nodes will see this reason when voting.
gov_vote_consensus: Vote registered. Consensus reached - change applied automatically.
gov_must_enter_value: You must enter a proposed value
gov_must_enter_domain: You must enter the domain of the node to expel
peers_your_pub_key: Your public key (share with other nodes):
peers_no_peers_hint: To federate with another node, register its domain and public key here, and ask the other node to register your public key.
peers_sponsorships_desc: Active sponsorships show the nodes that your node is backing as a sponsor. The limit held by each sponsorship is released when the sponsored node reaches Level 2.
peers_block_confirm: Block trade with {{domain}}? This will stop all transactions with that node. Only affects your node.
peers_block_success: Trade blocked with {{domain}}. Propagated to all peers.
peers_remove_confirm: Remove {{domain}} from the discovered nodes list?
gov_federated_gov_desc: Some values affect the ENTIRE federation (like the internal basic basket). They cannot be changed per individual node. To change them, a proposal is created and all federated nodes must approve it.
gov_default_threshold: By default 75% of nodes are required
gov_default_threshold_desc: (majority must approve). This threshold can be changed, but changing it requires approval under the current threshold. That is: if the current threshold is 75%, changing it to 100% or 50%+1 requires approval under 75%. Once changed, future proposals are approved with the new threshold.
gov_single_node_auto: When there is only one node, its proposals are auto-approved (it is 100% of 1 node). New nodes joining the federation accept existing policies.
gov_expel_warning_desc: This is a serious action. An expulsion proposal is created that nodes must approve (under the current threshold, default 75%). If approved, the expelled node cannot participate in the federation. To re-enter, it must request admission again and will automatically accept all existing rules.
limits_credit_hint: Maximum positive balance (in your favor) with this node.
limits_debit_hint: Maximum negative balance (debt) with this node.
discover_remove_confirm: Remove {{domain}} from the discovered nodes list?
discover_fed_confirmed: Node federated and confirmed successfully. Propagating to the entire network automatically...
gov_nodes_desc: Aqui appear all them nodes that pertenecen a it federacion, although no estes federated directly with all. Them decisions globales (votaciones) aplican a all them nodes of it network, because forman a cadena: if A this federated with B, and B with C, them decisions of A afectan a C although no esten directly federated.
parity_help_what: It paridad mide if the exchange between your node and other node federated this equilibrado or desequilibrado. Is as a balanza: of a lado estan them cosas that recibes of the other node (importaciones) and of the other lado them that envias (exportaciones).
parity_help_ratio: Is the resultado of divide importaciones between exportaciones.
parity_help_balanced: Equilibrado: importas and exportas it same.
parity_help_import_more: Importas mas of it that exportas (ej: 1.5 = importas 50% mas).
parity_help_export_more: Exportas mas of it that importas (ej: 0.5 = exportas the doble).
parity_help_only_import_desc: Has received products but never has sent nothing.
parity_help_only_export_desc: Has sent products but never has received nothing.
parity_help_imports: Total of TQ that has received of the other node (compras).
parity_help_exports: Total of TQ that has sent to the other node (ventas).
parity_help_balance: Exportaciones less importaciones. Positivo = you must. Negativo = debes.
parity_help_fc_label: On the Factor of Conversion (FC) - Important
parity_help_fc_no_affect: The FC NO afecta the price of them products. If vas a other node with your tarjeta and compras a product that cuesta 50, you cobran 50. The price is the same that this publicado in it tienda. There is no conversion ni change of price between nodes.
parity_help_fc_exterior: The FC is used exclusivamente in the comercio exterior: when Comercio Exterior compra products internamente for sell afuera or when compra products of afuera for traerlos to the node.
parity_help_fc_reference: The FC tambien sirve as referencia informativa for that them members sepan cuanto vale a product in currency local if decides pay directly between they.
parity_help_fc_local: Your Factor of Conversion. Is cuanto vale 1 unidad of currency in energia (kWh).
parity_help_fc_remote: The Factor of Conversion of the other node. Only appears if the other node it has compartido.
parity_help_purpose_label: For that sirve the reporte of paridad?
parity_help_purpose_1: Detectar relaciones comerciales desequilibradas between nodes.
parity_help_purpose_2: Decidir if ajustar them limites bilaterales with a node.
parity_help_purpose_4: Fomentar exchanges in areas where hay superavit.
parity_help_imbalance_1: If importas mucho: search products locales that puedas export to the other node.
parity_help_imbalance_2: If exportas mucho: considerar import products that necesites of the other node.
parity_help_imbalance_3: If this equilibrado: keep it relacion comercial current.
parity_help_suggestions: The system shows sugerencias when detecta desequilibrios. If it paridad is alta, sugiere aumentar the limite bilateral. If hay disparidad, sugiere no aumentar the limite.
gov_process_2: It proposal itself comparte with all them nodes federated
gov_process_4: When itself alcanza the umbral current (by defecto 75% = mayoria), the change applies in all
gov_process_5: If no itself alcanza the consensus, itself sigue using the value current
gov_threshold_change_desc: For change the umbral of aprobacion, is created a proposal as cualquier other. That proposal itself aprueba low the umbral current. A time approved, them futuras proposals usan the new umbral.
gov_expel_important_1: It proposal is created with the umbral current (by defecto 75%)
gov_expel_important_2: All them nodes must approve for that itself aplique
gov_expel_important_3: If itself aprueba, the node no podra federarse ni comerciar
gov_expel_important_4: The node expulsado can request reingreso despues
gov_expel_important_5: To the reingresar, hereda automaticamente all them rules existentes
peers_help_what: It federacion is a mecanismo that conecta your node local with nodes of other communities, permitiendo that them users of your network of exchange puedan comerciar with users of other networks federadas, without necesidad of a bank or entidad central.
peers_help_purpose: Allows extender the alcance of it network of exchange mas alla of your community local.
peers_help_peer: A node peer (par) is other node of it network of exchange that has registrado in your system for establecer a conexion federated.
peers_help_register: Haz clic in Registrar Node Peer, complete the form with the domain, name and key publica of the other node, and saves.
peers_help_domain: Is the identificador unico of the node in it network federated, normalmente a name of domain of internet.
peers_help_keys: Are identificadores criptograficos basados in the algoritmo Ed25519 (64 caracteres hexadecimales) that identifican univocamente a each node.
peers_help_comm_label: As works it comunicacion between nodes:
peers_help_comm: When two nodes itself federan mutuamente, establecen a canal safe using its keys publicas. Them transactions between users of distintos nodes itself envian via HTTPS, firmadas criptograficamente.
peers_help_state_active: The node this registrado and it federacion is mutua (ambos have been registrado).
peers_help_state_pending: The node this registrado of your lado but the other node aun no you has registrado.
peers_help_state_mutual: Indica that ambos nodes have been registrado mutuamente and it federacion this active.
peers_help_levels_desc: Each node has a level that determina its limite and capacidades:
peers_help_level1: Limite 1.000 TQ, without vote, without patrocinio. Minimo 90 dias antes of promocion.
peers_help_level2: Limite 5.000 TQ, with vote and capacidad of patrocinar. Itself alcanza by votacion of it federacion.
peers_help_level3: Limite 20.000 TQ. Promocion automatica to the cumplir reciprocidad and limite average.
peers_help_effective: The limite efectivo of a node is its limite nominal less the limite retenido by patrocinios activos.
peers_help_pool: Ademas of them saldos bilaterales between pares of nodes, exists a piscina global compartida. The balance that ganas in a node is gastable in cualquier other node federated.
peers_help_usage: Copy your key publica and enviasela to the admin of the other node. Pide it key publica of the other node. Registra the other node aqui. Pide to the other node that you registre a ti.
peers_help_auto: When a node new itself federa with a sponsor via verificacion of 4 options, the sponsor propaga automaticamente it info of the new node a all its peers in cadena exponencial.
peers_help_block: Puedes bloquear comercio with a node especifico without necesidad of acuerdo. Only afecta a your node.
limits_help_what_label: That are them limites between nodes:
limits_help_what: Are them topes maximos of balance (positivo or negativo) that your node can tener with each node peer federated. Sirven for controlar the riesgo.
limits_help_purpose: Allow gestionar the riesgo of credito between nodes federated. Without limites, a node podria acumular a debt ilimitada with other.
limits_help_credit_label: That is the limite of credito:
limits_help_credit: Is the balance positivo maximo that your node can tener with other node. That is, it maximo that the other node you can owe a ti.
limits_help_debit_label: That is the limite of debito:
limits_help_debit: Is the balance negativo maximo (debt) that your node can tener with other node. That is, it maximo that your node him can owe to the other.
limits_help_trade_label: As works the comercio between nodes:
limits_help_trade: When a user of your node compra something a a user of other node federated, the balance bilateral cambia. The system verifica that them limites no itself excedan antes of approve it transaccion.
limits_help_global: Debt/balance maximo total of the node with all it network federated. Aplica a all them nodes to the level base.
limits_help_bilateral: Limite personalizado between two nodes especificos. If two nodes acuerdan a limite greater, NO consume the limite global.
limits_help_effective: The limite efectivo between two nodes = min(limite_A_hacia_B, limite_B_hacia_A). Ambos nodes must subirlo for that aplique the new value.
limits_help_base: Limite inicial igual for all them pares (ej: 50% of the global). Can be personalizar despues node by node.
limits_help_thresholds: Porcentajes of the limite (ej: 50%/75%/90%) that disparan notifications when the balance itself acerca to the limite.
limits_help_usage: Revisa it configuracion global. For personalizar the limite with a node especifico, haz clic in Propose Bilateral, selects the node e ingresa them new limites.
merge_error_enter_domain: Ingresa the domain of the other node
merge_conflicts_detected: {{count}} conflicts detected. Review and propose resolutions.
merge_no_conflicts_clean: There is no conflictos. Them nodes can federarse without duplicados.
merge_confirm_execute: Confirm ejecucion of it resolucion? This accion migrara to the user and procesara the balance.
merge_combine_desc: Combinar: sum ambos saldos (positivo+positivo=mas positivo, negativo+negativo=mas negativo, positivo+negativo=itself compensan).
merge_notes_placeholder: Explica the razonamiento of it assembly...
federation_sync_desc2: between nodes federated. When a node cambia its domain, IP, WireGuard or services, all them demas it receive automaticamente. No necesitas share nothing manually.
federation_sync_started: Sincronizacion iniciada. Them nodes federated recibiran it info actualizada.
federation_no_peers: There is no nodes federated with info of network.
federation_no_peers_hint: Federate with other aldea in "Federate Aldeas" for view its info aqui.
peers_method_auto_desc: Usa it verificacion of 4 options in it pagina of Descubrimiento of Nodes. To the confirm, the node itself federara automaticamente with all it network via propagacion in cadena.
peers_manual_step1: Copy your key publica (arriba) and enviasela to the admin of the other node
peers_manual_step2: Pide it key publica of the other node
peers_manual_step3: Registra the other node aqui (domain + key publica)
peers_manual_step4: Pide to the other node that you registre a ti
peers_manual_step5: When ambos have been registrado, it federacion this active
peers_manual_note: Nota: The metodo manual only registra the peer localmente. For that the new node between a all it network automaticamente, usa it verificacion of 4 options.
